words.definition: The way two people feel and behave toward each other.
words.example: They've been in a relationship for five years.

words.definition: To become husband and wife.
words.example: They plan to marry next spring.

words.definition: The legal end of a marriage.

words.definition: Having agreed to marry someone.
words.example: They got engaged last weekend.

words.definition: A person you are married to or in a relationship with.

words.definition: Showing or causing feelings of love.
words.example: That was such a romantic dinner.

words.definition: A short, strong feeling of love for someone, usually secret.
words.example: I had a crush on my teacher.

words.definition: To ask someone to marry you.
words.example: He proposed to her on the beach.

words.definition: A trip taken by a couple just after their wedding.
words.example: They spent their honeymoon in Italy.

words.definition: Not married and not in a relationship.

words.definition: The feeling you get when you think something bad may happen.
words.example: She has a fear of flying.

words.definition: The ability to do something that scares you.

words.definition: A talk given to a group of people.

words.definition: Something you say to make people laugh.

words.definition: Helping you do or get something.

words.definition: A farm animal with thick wool.

words.definition: A word that shows surprise.
words.example: Gosh, it's late!

words.definition: A word you say when you are happy.
words.example: Yay! School is out.

words.definition: A small, simple building.
